method: Flatten future latent blocks 1:4; across-window population variance averaged over coordinates; PCA spectral effective rank exp(entropy) from centered sample Gram eigenvalues. Two windows per episode; bootstrap resamples episodes with replacement and uses the same draw for both modalities. Start/end results use one corresponding window per sampled episode; mixed results retain both.
caveats: Effective rank is sample- and spectrum-dependent, upper bounded by windows minus one; bootstrap repetitions duplicate trajectories and can bias finite-sample spectral ranks. Percentile intervals are approximate descriptive uncertainty, not formal proof or correction for sampling design. Window stages can mix and overlap; trajectories can be correlated or unrepresentative. Variance depends on encoding scales; low variation or rank does not prove predictive ease, information preservation, or downstream performance.
